book.title: Cambridge International AS & A Level Mathematics: Probability & Statistics 1
book.author: Dean Chalmers
book.policy: Book informs concepts and teaching structure; notes, numerical examples and short checks are independently written. No textbook exercises or artwork are copied.

syllabus.current: 2026–2027, Version 5, as retrieved from official PDF
syllabus.notes: Descriptive spread, raw/grouped/coded data, and combinations of up to two data sets. Algebra uses P1 skills. The five working blocks below are editorial, not five official syllabus sections.

conventions.variance: Descriptive variance uses divisor n, not n−1.
conventions.rounding: Give non-exact numerical answers to 3 significant figures, retaining exact intermediate totals. Counts and explicitly requested totals are exact.
conventions.quartiles: For ungrouped data, use medians of the lower and upper halves, excluding the overall median when the count is odd. Repeated in relevant conditions.
conventions.grouped_data: Class-midpoint estimates for moments. Linear interpolation for cumulative frequencies is explicitly stated.
conventions.summaries: All summary quantities are exact unless stated to be estimates.

sourceCheckSpecifications: Retained privately as specifications only; written reasoning, final-answer rounding judgement and method marks use the existing manual/teacher workflow.
